collection.title: Vauxhall Corsa Hatchback 2019 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Vauxhall Corsa 2019 Onwards requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Corsa which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
